# pvecli node

Manage cluster nodes.

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`shutdown`](shutdown.md) | Shutdown a node. Proxmox will stop all guests before powering off. |
| [`reboot`](reboot.md) | Reboot a node. Proxmox will stop all guests before rebooting. |
| [`evacuate`](evacuate.md) | Move every guest off a node before maintenance. |
| [`maintenance`](maintenance.md) | Prepare a node for manual maintenance, then bring it back. |
| [`updates`](updates.md) | Pending package updates per node (read only unless --refresh). |
| [`vnc`](vnc.md) | Open authenticated VNC shell(s) for one or more nodes. |
| [`ssh`](ssh.md) | SSH into a Proxmox node. |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all cluster nodes. |
| [`info`](info.md) | Show detailed information about a node. |
